nhl.source_name: NHL official stats REST API — team summary, season 20262027, gameType 2 (regular season)
nhl.snapshot_note: Snapshot is through games played on 2026-10-21; cross-checked against the api-web.nhle.com /v1/score/2026-10-23 feed, which reported identical W-L-OTL records for MTL (4-3-2), TBL (7-2-0), COL (5-4-1) and CHI (3-6-0). GF/GA from this REST view excludes the shootout-deciding goal (documented in METHODOLOGY.md as flag F19).
nhl.model: multiplicative Poisson on goals for/against, shrinkage gp/(gp+8), home factor 1.05

euroleague.source_name: EuroLeague Basketball official game centre and official standings
euroleague.model: attack/defence points model, shrinkage gp/(gp+6), +3.0 home points, normal margin sd 11.0

urc.source_name: United Rugby Championship official match centre (URC)
urc.model: attack/defence points model, shrinkage pl/(pl+6), +3.0 home points, normal margin sd 13.0, draw band +/-3 points

ehf.source_name: EHF Champions League Men 2026/27 official standings (ehfcl.eurohandball.com)
ehf.model: attack/defence Poisson on goals, shrinkage gp/(gp+3), +/-0.4 home goals, full score grid
ehf.consistency_check: goals_for_total equals goals_against_total across the 24 clubs, as it must: 3501 v 3501

mlb.source_name: MLB Stats API official standings endpoint
mlb.note: Regular-season standings, all 30 clubs. Yankees and Orioles had played 161 games at capture; every other club 162. Per-game rates are used so the unequal sample is handled.
mlb.model: attack/defence Poisson on runs, shrinkage gp/(gp+20), +0.25 home runs, ties split 50/50 for extra innings

f1.rounds_completed_note: The official 2026 calendar page lists Round 17 Singapore (09-11 Oct) as the previous, completed round and Round 18 United States (23-25 Oct) as next; Round 19 Mexico follows (30 Oct-01 Nov). Seventeen rounds are therefore complete before Round 18.
f1.model: share-of-championship-points outright; head-to-head between the top two by points share

wst.source_name: World Snooker Tour official matches page - BetVictor Northern Ireland Open 2026
wst.time_note: Times and the day label are reproduced verbatim from the official page, which does not state the timezone in the fetched rendering. Two fixtures listed at 09:00 may already have started when this page is published; disclosed as flag CU-03 rather than resolved by assumption.
wst.model: exact best-of-seven frame distribution; per-frame win rate from captured frames, shrunk matches/(matches+6) toward 0.5
